landing.hero.headline: The headless engine for your next SaaS.
landing.hero.subheadline: Auth, payments, subscriptions, credits, RBAC, CMS, and i18n — all pre-wired. Just build your product on top.
landing.features.title: Everything you need to ship
landing.features.description: Pre-wired business logic so you can focus on building your product.
landing.features.auth.title: Authentication
landing.features.auth.description: Email/password, Google, and GitHub OAuth — ready out of the box with session management and account linking.
landing.features.payment.title: Payments
landing.features.payment.description: Stripe, PayPal, Alipay, WeChat Pay — checkout, subscriptions, webhooks, and order management.
landing.features.rbac.title: Roles & Permissions
landing.features.rbac.description: Fine-grained RBAC with wildcard matching. Full admin panel for managing users, roles, and permissions.
landing.features.i18n.title: Internationalization
landing.features.i18n.description: English and Chinese built-in with locale-aware routing. Easy to extend with additional languages.
landing.features.cms.title: Content Management
landing.features.cms.description: Categories and posts with full CRUD, status management, and admin panel — build your blog or docs.
landing.features.credits.title: Credit System
landing.features.credits.description: FIFO consumption, expiration, auto-grant on signup, and revocation — ready for usage-based billing.
landing.pricing.title: Pricing
landing.pricing.description: Choose the plan that works for you.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.description: Everything you need to know before getting started.
landing.faq.stack.question: What's the tech stack?
landing.faq.stack.answer: Next.js 16 with the App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Drizzle ORM, and better-auth. Every piece of business logic is inlined — no external packages for payment, email, storage, or AI.
landing.faq.payment.question: Which payment providers are supported?
landing.faq.payment.answer: Stripe, PayPal, Creem, Alipay, and WeChat Pay out of the box. The PaymentManager abstraction makes it straightforward to add more providers by implementing a single interface.
landing.faq.database.question: Which databases can I use?
landing.faq.database.answer: Drizzle ORM handles PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Turso, and Cloudflare D1. Switch providers by editing DATABASE_PROVIDER in your .env — the schema templates and drizzle config adapt automatically.
landing.faq.customize.question: How customizable is the landing page?
landing.faq.customize.answer: The src/blocks/ directory ships with demo sections — they're designed to be rewritten per project. The durable primitives live in src/components/, so your rebrand touches blocks and translations, not the chassis.
landing.faq.license.question: Can I use this for commercial projects?
landing.faq.license.answer: Yes. ShipAny Next is built for shipping production SaaS products. You own the code after cloning — no per-seat fees, no runtime dependencies on our infrastructure.
landing.cta.headline: Ready to ship your SaaS?
landing.cta.subheadline: Stop wiring auth, payments, and RBAC from scratch. Start with ShipAny Next and build what actually makes your product unique.

campaign.home.featured.title: Thirteen missions, one clear route through the campaign
campaign.home.featured.description: The classic ten-mission arc is joined by three Operation: Meteor prequel missions. Our index separates verified release facts from provisional planning notes.
campaign.home.prepare.title: Prepare the run, not just the loadout
campaign.home.prepare.body: A reliable campaign plan covers navigation, recovery and team communication before the first encounter begins.
campaign.home.prepare.bullet1: Choose complementary ranges instead of duplicating the same weapon role.
campaign.home.prepare.bullet2: Agree on regroup points before vehicles, lifts and narrow transitions.
campaign.home.prepare.bullet3: Record skull and collectible checks at natural objective breaks.
campaign.home.systems.title: Understand the expanded campaign sandbox
campaign.home.systems.description: Use verified feature facts as the foundation, then apply practical editorial guidance at the table.
campaign.home.systems.sandbox.title: Expanded sandbox
campaign.home.systems.sandbox.body: Nine additional weapons broaden the possible role combinations across the campaign.
campaign.home.systems.coop.title: Co-op options
campaign.home.systems.coop.body: Plan for online squads or local split-screen where the supported platform allows it.
campaign.home.systems.skulls.title: Skull checklist
campaign.home.systems.skulls.body: Mission pages reserve a repeatable checklist for skulls, collectibles and return visits.
campaign.home.systems.meteor.title: Operation: Meteor
campaign.home.systems.meteor.body: Three prequel missions extend the campaign. Unverified mission names and objectives remain clearly labeled.
campaign.home.field.title: A manual designed to stay useful after launch
campaign.home.field.body: The editorial model is deliberately simple: verify facts, flag uncertainty and revise mission notes after hands-on confirmation.
campaign.home.field.bullet1: Every major route uses a stable, crawlable English URL.
campaign.home.field.bullet2: Mission advice is separated from official specifications and release facts.
campaign.home.field.bullet3: Updates focus on objective clarity, accessibility and practical co-op play.
campaign.home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
campaign.home.faq.description: Quick answers about the site, release timing, co-op and spoilers.
campaign.home.faq.official.question: Is Campaign Evolved Manual an official website?
campaign.home.faq.official.answer: No. It is an independent editorial companion and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's publisher, developer or platform holders.
campaign.home.faq.release.question: When does Campaign Evolved release?
campaign.home.faq.release.answer: The verified release date is July 28, 2026. Premium early access is listed for July 23, 2026.
campaign.home.faq.coop.question: How many players can play co-op?
campaign.home.faq.coop.answer: The supplied official references list up to four-player online co-op and two-player local split-screen on supported consoles, plus cross-play and cross-progression.
campaign.home.faq.spoilers.question: Do the guides contain spoilers?
campaign.home.faq.spoilers.answer: Index pages stay spoiler-light. Mission articles describe objective structure and encounter preparation, so readers should expect limited tactical spoilers.
campaign.home.faq.updates.question: How will mission information be updated?
campaign.home.faq.updates.answer: Pre-release planning notes are labeled. After release, objective order, collectibles and encounter guidance will be revised only after source or hands-on verification.

campaign.missions.meta.description: Browse all 13 Campaign Evolved mission briefings, including the classic campaign arc and three Operation: Meteor prequel missions.
campaign.missions.title: Mission briefings
campaign.missions.description: A spoiler-light planning index for the 13-mission campaign, with tactical preparation, objective outlines and co-op notes.
campaign.missions.prerelease_notice: Pre-release note: the classic mission flow below is an editorial planning model based on the established campaign arc. Campaign Evolved may alter encounters, routes and collectible placement. Operation: Meteor labels are editorial placeholders until official mission names are verified.
campaign.missions.index_description: The ten classic chapters and three verified Operation: Meteor prequel slots are kept in one stable, locale-neutral route set.
campaign.missions.editorial_label_notice: Editorial route label — not a verified official mission title.
campaign.mission_detail.meta.title: {mission} Walkthrough – Campaign Evolved Manual
campaign.mission_detail.planning_notice: This pre-release walkthrough is a planning guide, not a claim that the remake preserves every route or encounter. Objective details will be verified and revised after release.
campaign.mission_detail.meteor_notice: Operation: Meteor is confirmed as a three-mission prequel. This page uses an editorial route label; official title, objective order and collectible details are intentionally not invented.
campaign.mission_detail.objective_note: Provisional planning order based on the classic campaign shape; verify in-game markers at launch.
campaign.missions.pillar.title: The Pillar of Autumn
campaign.missions.pillar.summary: Escape a failing ship while learning the campaign's core movement, shield and weapon rhythms.
campaign.missions.pillar.overview: A compact opening mission built around orientation, corridor combat and a final evacuation push. Treat it as the place to tune sensitivity, subtitles and combat readability before the spaces grow larger.
campaign.missions.pillar.approach: Keep one dependable mid-range option, clear side rooms before crossing exposed corridors and avoid spending every grenade on early groups. The escape route rewards steady forward movement more than exhaustive backtracking.
campaign.missions.pillar.objective1: Complete the opening orientation and confirm control, audio and subtitle settings.
campaign.missions.pillar.objective2: Reach the command area, then follow the marked evacuation route through the ship.
campaign.missions.pillar.objective3: Protect enough shield to survive the final corridor pressure and board an escape craft.
campaign.missions.pillar.warning: Tight geometry can hide flanking enemies and stray explosives. Pause at doorframes, read the room and leave a clear retreat lane.
campaign.missions.pillar.check1: Check tutorial and accessibility options before leaving the opening area.
campaign.missions.pillar.check2: Scan side rooms without losing the main evacuation route.
campaign.missions.pillar.check3: Record any skull or collectible only after an in-game confirmation.
campaign.missions.pillar.coop: Assign the lead player to navigation and the second to rear security. Regroup before narrow doors so a respawn does not pull the team backward.
campaign.missions.halo.title: Halo
campaign.missions.halo.summary: Cross an open landscape, locate scattered survivors and learn how vehicles reshape encounter flow.
campaign.missions.halo.overview: The first broad outdoor chapter shifts the campaign from corridors to navigation, survivor defense and multi-part objectives. Sightlines, landmarks and vehicle preservation matter as much as raw damage.
campaign.missions.halo.approach: Use high ground to read each rescue area before entering. Keep the vehicle parked facing an exit, clear heavy pressure first and only then sweep for supplies or optional discoveries.
campaign.missions.halo.objective1: Stabilize the landing area and establish a safe route into the valley.
campaign.missions.halo.objective2: Locate the separated survivor groups and secure each position.
campaign.missions.halo.objective3: Use the extraction cue only after the active rescue area is fully controlled.
campaign.missions.halo.warning: Wide spaces invite overextension. Do not split so far that a downed co-op partner cannot be recovered without crossing an active firing lane.
campaign.missions.halo.check1: Mark major landmarks before leaving the first valley.
campaign.missions.halo.check2: Inspect rescue zones after combat, not during the defense wave.
campaign.missions.halo.check3: Track which branch areas have been cleared to avoid unnecessary loops.
campaign.missions.halo.coop: Use a driver and navigator callout pair. Dismount together before dense cover so the squad does not arrive in separate waves.
campaign.missions.truth.title: The Truth and Reconciliation
campaign.missions.truth.summary: A night approach and shipboard rescue that rewards quiet target priority and disciplined close-quarters movement.
campaign.missions.truth.overview: This mission moves from a long-range exterior approach into a denser interior rescue. The change in space makes ammunition planning and role coverage especially important.
campaign.missions.truth.approach: Preserve precision ammunition for exposed priority targets, then swap one slot toward close-range control before boarding. Inside, clear balconies and doorways before chasing objective markers.
campaign.missions.truth.objective1: Advance through the night approach while keeping the fireteam together.
campaign.missions.truth.objective2: Secure the boarding zone and transition into the ship interior.
campaign.missions.truth.objective3: Locate the rescue target and create a controlled route back out.
campaign.missions.truth.warning: Vertical rooms create crossfire from levels that are easy to miss. Check upper platforms before committing to the center of a chamber.
campaign.missions.truth.check1: Review the approach area before using the boarding transition.
campaign.missions.truth.check2: Note locked or one-way doors that may affect backtracking.
campaign.missions.truth.check3: Confirm optional pickups before initiating the rescue exit.
campaign.missions.truth.coop: Split roles by range on the exterior, then pair up in the ship. Call elevators and room transitions before activating them.
campaign.missions.cartographer.title: The Silent Cartographer
campaign.missions.cartographer.summary: Secure a beachhead, search a branching island and reach the map facility with a clean escape route.
campaign.missions.cartographer.overview: A famous open-ended island operation built around a beach landing, reconnaissance and an underground objective. Its branching roads reward landmark awareness and deliberate vehicle placement.
campaign.missions.cartographer.approach: Clear the beach perimeter before pushing inland. Treat the vehicle as a reusable mobility tool, park it out of direct fire and check route gates before driving deep into a branch.
campaign.missions.cartographer.objective: Establish the beachhead and secure a reliable vehicle route.
Reconnoiter the island branches and resolve the facility access requirement.
Reach the map room, then retrace a controlled path to extraction.
campaign.missions.cartographer.warning: The island's loops can make a wrong turn feel productive. Use coastline, elevation and major structures as navigation anchors.
campaign.missions.cartographer.check1: Sweep the beach only after the landing defense is complete.
campaign.missions.cartographer.check2: Track which island branch has been checked.
campaign.missions.cartographer.check3: Complete underground checks before triggering the return route.
campaign.missions.cartographer.coop: Nominate one driver and one route caller. On foot, clear opposite sides of a chamber without losing line of sight to the regroup point.
campaign.missions.control.title: Assault on the Control Room
campaign.missions.control.summary: A long combined-arms advance through changing elevations, vehicle spaces and fortified interiors.
campaign.missions.control.overview: A sustained push that alternates between enclosed transitions and large combat arenas. Success depends on preserving useful weapons and vehicles across several distinct encounter types.
campaign.missions.control.approach: Enter each large space slowly enough to identify armor, elevated fire and safe cover. Replace depleted weapons before transitions and avoid abandoning a healthy vehicle for a short shortcut.
campaign.missions.control.objective1: Break out of the opening interior and secure transport for the exterior route.
campaign.missions.control.objective2: Cross the major valleys and fortified transitions without exhausting heavy resources.
campaign.missions.control.objective3: Complete the final ascent and secure the control-room approach.
campaign.missions.control.warning: Long encounters punish resource drift. If a fight consumes every explosive or vehicle, pause and search the cleared zone before the next checkpoint.
campaign.missions.control.check1: Check major vehicle staging areas after they are secure.
campaign.missions.control.check2: Record side paths before irreversible lifts or doors.
campaign.missions.control.check3: Preserve a ranged option for the final approach.
campaign.missions.control.coop: Give each player a defined role around vehicles: driver, gunner, anti-armor and rear security. Regroup before lifts and bridges.
campaign.missions.spark.title: 343 Guilty Spark
campaign.missions.spark.summary: Investigate a silent facility where navigation, audio cues and a reliable retreat lane become critical.
campaign.missions.spark.overview: A mystery-driven chapter with limited visibility, layered interiors and a major shift in encounter pressure. Spoiler-light planning emphasizes orientation and space control.
campaign.missions.spark.approach: Use lights, doors and environmental landmarks to build a mental map. Favor weapons that recover quickly at close range and do not push through a threshold until the current room is stable.
campaign.missions.spark.objective1: Trace the missing unit's route through the swamp and locate the facility entrance.
campaign.missions.spark.objective2: Investigate the interior while preserving a recognizable path back.
campaign.missions.spark.objective3: Respond to the encounter shift and move toward the extraction route.
campaign.missions.spark.warning: This chapter contains a significant campaign reveal. The manual avoids naming it here, but close-range pressure and attacks from behind should be expected.
campaign.missions.spark.check1: Use exterior lights and structures as return-route markers.
campaign.missions.spark.check2: Finish optional room checks before the mission changes pace.
campaign.missions.spark.check3: Do not backtrack alone after the major encounter shift.
campaign.missions.spark.coop: Move as a compact pair or squad and assign rear security. Call every door transition because enemies can pressure the group from multiple directions.
campaign.missions.library.title: The Library
campaign.missions.library.summary: Maintain formation through repeated close-range pressure while following a guide toward the Index.
campaign.missions.library.overview: A long interior endurance mission built around repeated waves, door holds and vertical repetition. Navigation is straightforward; resource and formation discipline are the real challenge.
campaign.missions.library.approach: Prioritize sustainable close-range control, keep an emergency lane open and reload during quiet movement rather than at a locked door. Do not chase isolated enemies away from the route.
campaign.missions.library.objective1: Follow the guide through the first set of chambers and learn the door-hold rhythm.
campaign.missions.library.objective2: Maintain ammunition and shields across the repeated floors and pressure waves.
campaign.missions.library.objective3: Complete the final approach and secure the Index objective.
campaign.missions.library.warning: Fatigue causes more failures than a single elite threat. Take safe pauses, confirm team readiness and avoid spending every grenade at the start of a wave.
campaign.missions.library.check1: Inspect quiet transition rooms rather than active hold points.
campaign.missions.library.check2: Use repeated architecture to note the current floor and direction.
campaign.missions.library.check3: Confirm supplies before activating the final approach.
campaign.missions.library.coop: Alternate front and rear security instead of stacking every player at one door. Announce reloads and preserve one player as a safe respawn anchor.
campaign.missions.betrayals.title: Two Betrayals
campaign.missions.betrayals.summary: Revisit a large battlefield under new pressure and disable a series of separated objectives.
campaign.missions.betrayals.overview: A return through familiar large-scale spaces with different threats and a multi-point objective chain. Route memory helps, but the altered encounter mix requires new priorities.
campaign.missions.betrayals.approach: Treat each generator area as a separate operation: scout, secure transport, clear escape lanes, complete the objective and regroup before moving on. Preserve anti-vehicle resources.
campaign.missions.betrayals.objective1: Exit the control-room area and establish the first safe movement route.
campaign.missions.betrayals.objective2: Reach and disable the separated pulse-generator objectives.
campaign.missions.betrayals.objective3: Survive the final return leg with enough mobility for extraction.
campaign.missions.betrayals.warning: Familiar terrain can hide changed enemy placement. Re-scout every arena instead of assuming the earlier mission's safe route still works.
campaign.missions.betrayals.check1: Recheck reopened spaces for newly accessible side routes.
campaign.missions.betrayals.check2: Finish each generator-area sweep before leaving its transport behind.
campaign.missions.betrayals.check3: Track the completed objective count before long travel segments.
campaign.missions.betrayals.coop: Keep an anti-vehicle role supplied and designate a safe anchor during generator interactions. Avoid moving every player into the objective radius at once.
campaign.missions.keyes.title: Keyes
campaign.missions.keyes.summary: Infiltrate a compromised ship, locate the captain and escape through dense, multi-faction combat.
campaign.missions.keyes.overview: A rescue operation through hazardous interiors and contested hangars. Multiple sources of pressure make target selection and a disciplined exit route more important than clearing every corner.
campaign.missions.keyes.approach: Let opposing threats reduce each other before entering the center of a fight. Keep a close-range control option, watch vertical balconies and save mobility resources for the escape sequence.
campaign.missions.keyes.objective1: Enter the ship and establish a route through the compromised interior.
campaign.missions.keyes.objective2: Locate the captain's position while avoiding unnecessary crossfire.
campaign.missions.keyes.objective3: Reach the hangar and secure a reliable extraction path.
campaign.missions.keyes.warning: Multi-directional fights can collapse a safe position quickly. Keep the nearest cleared doorway available and do not pursue targets into an unscouted level.
campaign.missions.keyes.check1: Complete side-room checks before committing to deep ship transitions.
campaign.missions.keyes.check2: Confirm the route back to the hangar after the rescue objective changes.
campaign.missions.keyes.check3: Do not delay collectible checks once extraction begins.
campaign.missions.keyes.coop: Use crossfire patiently, but keep the team within one room of each other. Assign one player to watch the previous doorway during searches.
campaign.missions.maw.title: The Maw
campaign.missions.maw.summary: Return to the wreck, complete the final sabotage plan and commit to a timed escape route.
campaign.missions.maw.overview: The finale combines familiar ship geometry, a multi-step sabotage objective and a decisive vehicle escape. Preparation before the final transition matters more than optional scavenging afterward.
campaign.missions.maw.approach: Carry one dependable close-range option into the ship, clear the engineering space before interacting with objectives and learn the vehicle controls before the timed run begins.
campaign.missions.maw.objective1: Re-enter the wreck and reach the engineering objective with adequate supplies.
campaign.missions.maw.objective2: Complete the sabotage sequence and move immediately toward the escape vehicle.
campaign.missions.maw.objective3: Follow the fastest readable route through the timed final escape.
campaign.missions.maw.warning: The final run rewards clean driving and recovery, not constant maximum speed. A controlled correction is faster than repeated collisions.
campaign.missions.maw.check1: Finish all optional checks before committing to the sabotage sequence.
campaign.missions.maw.check2: Confirm the escape vehicle and route before the timer begins.
campaign.missions.maw.check3: Treat the timed section as a no-backtracking point.
campaign.missions.maw.coop: Choose the strongest driver before the finale and let the other players call turns and hazards. Avoid competing navigation calls.
campaign.missions.meteor1.title: Operation: Meteor 01 — Incursion
campaign.missions.meteor1.summary: Editorial route for the first of three confirmed prequel missions; official mission title and objectives await verification.
campaign.missions.meteor1.overview: Campaign Evolved is confirmed to include three Operation: Meteor prequel missions. This page reserves a stable location for the first briefing without presenting an editorial label as official information.
campaign.missions.meteor1.approach: Before launch, use this briefing only for squad readiness: confirm difficulty, communication, input and accessibility settings. Mission-specific advice will follow verified play or source material.
campaign.missions.meteor2.title: Operation: Meteor 02 — Breakpoint
campaign.missions.meteor2.summary: Editorial route for the second confirmed prequel slot, held free of invented story or objective claims.
campaign.missions.meteor2.overview: The second of three prequel missions has a reserved manual entry so its guide URL remains stable. No unverified story beats, locations or encounters are asserted here.
campaign.missions.meteor2.approach: Plan a flexible two-role loadout and a regroup protocol, but follow the live briefing in-game. This page will add tactical detail only after the mission is verified.

campaign.missions.meteor3.overview: This entry completes the three-slot Operation: Meteor index. Its route name is editorial and does not claim to reveal the official finale, story outcome or mission structure.
campaign.missions.meteor3.approach: Reserve this page as a spoiler-controlled checklist. At launch, confirm objective order and no-return points before adding collectible or encounter directions.
campaign.missions.meteor.shared.objectiv: Read the in-game briefing and confirm the mission's official title and first objective.

campaign.missions.meteor.shared.check1: Confirm the official mission title from an authoritative or in-game source.
campaign.missions.meteor.shared.check2: Record skull and collectible locations only after direct verification.
campaign.missions.meteor.shared.check3: Mark story spoilers before adding them to the manual.
campaign.missions.meteor.shared.coop: Use a simple lead-and-anchor formation until the mission geometry is known. Call transitions before the full squad crosses them.
campaign.arsenal.meta.title: Campaign Evolved Arsenal Guide – Weapons & Loadout Planning
campaign.arsenal.meta.description: Plan Campaign Evolved weapon roles, shield pressure, ammunition economy and co-op loadouts, with clear notes on the nine additional weapons.
campaign.arsenal.title: Arsenal reference
campaign.arsenal.description: A role-based field guide to loadout decisions across short, medium and long-range campaign encounters.
campaign.arsenal.verified_notice: Verified feature fact: Campaign Evolved adds nine weapons to the expanded sandbox. Individual names and statistics are not listed here until they are confirmed by an authoritative or in-game source.
campaign.arsenal.categories_description: Weapon names can change; range, shield pressure, burst control and ammunition economy remain useful planning categories.
campaign.arsenal.precision.title: Precision control
campaign.arsenal.precision.body: Use a dependable mid-to-long range role to remove exposed priority targets and reduce pressure before crossing open ground.
campaign.arsenal.precision.note: Co-op note: give precision ammunition to the player with the clearest sightline rather than splitting every pickup evenly.
campaign.arsenal.plasma.title: Shield pressure
campaign.arsenal.plasma.body: Pair fast shield removal with a reliable finishing option. Swap roles when one ammunition pool becomes scarce.
campaign.arsenal.plasma.note: Watch heat or charge behavior and avoid starting the decisive push with an unavailable weapon.
campaign.arsenal.close.title: Close-range control
campaign.arsenal.close.body: Reserve one slot for doorways, confined rooms and sudden rear pressure, especially in later interior missions.
campaign.arsenal.close.note: Do not let every player crowd the same threshold; one close-range anchor is often enough.
campaign.arsenal.explosive.title: Explosive response
campaign.arsenal.explosive.body: Treat rockets, grenades and other heavy burst tools as solutions for armor, clustered threats or a failed defensive position.
campaign.arsenal.explosive.note: Keep a safe firing lane and call the shot in co-op before using splash damage near the squad.
campaign.arsenal.support.title: Sustained support
campaign.arsenal.support.body: A high-uptime support role protects movement between cover and prevents smaller threats from draining the whole team's attention.
campaign.arsenal.support.note: Rotate support fire during reloads so the encounter never loses all suppression at once.
campaign.arsenal.nine_title: What the nine additional weapons change
campaign.arsenal.nine_body: More weapons do not require a longer shopping list. Evaluate each addition by the role it replaces, the ammunition it competes for and whether it improves the current squad's range coverage. The manual will publish names and measured behavior only after verification.
campaign.enemies.meta.title: Campaign Evolved Enemy Guide – Threats & Counterplay
campaign.enemies.meta.description: A spoiler-aware Campaign Evolved enemy guide organized by battlefield role, pressure pattern and practical counterplay.
campaign.enemies.title: Enemy field guide
campaign.enemies.description: Read the battlefield by role and behavior, then choose a response that protects position, ammunition and team recovery.
campaign.enemies.editorial_notice: These profiles are editorial combat categories, not an official bestiary or a claim about exact health, damage or spawn values in Campaign Evolved.
campaign.enemies.profiles_description: The most dangerous target is often the one changing the room, not the one closest to the reticle.
campaign.enemies.infantry.title: Mobile infantry
campaign.enemies.infantry.body: Numerous mobile units create crossfire, consume attention and punish players who tunnel on one durable target.
campaign.enemies.infantry.tactic: Reduce exposed numbers first, then push while the firing lanes are quiet.
campaign.enemies.shielded.title: Shielded duelists
campaign.enemies.shielded.body: Durable front-line opponents can hold a doorway and protect weaker support behind them.
campaign.enemies.shielded.tactic: Break shield pressure as a team, then finish quickly before it recovers.
campaign.enemies.support.title: Elevated support
campaign.enemies.support.body: Long-range or elevated units constrain movement and make otherwise safe cover unreliable.
campaign.enemies.support.tactic: Find the sightline first; remove or suppress support before crossing open ground.
campaign.enemies.armored.title: Armored pressure
campaign.enemies.armored.body: Vehicles and heavily protected threats demand space, concentrated damage and an exit route.
campaign.enemies.armored.tactic: Keep heavy ammunition for a clear exposure window instead of firing into bad angles.
campaign.enemies.outbreak.title: Close-range outbreak
campaign.enemies.outbreak.body: Later campaign encounters can shift toward dense, multi-directional pressure and rapid space loss.
campaign.enemies.outbreak.tactic: Maintain rear security, sustainable close-range control and a cleared retreat lane.
campaign.vehicles.meta.title: Campaign Evolved Vehicle Guide – Crew Roles & Tactics
campaign.vehicles.meta.description: Campaign Evolved vehicle planning for scouting, armor, air support, transport, co-op crew roles and recovery routes.
campaign.vehicles.title: Vehicle operations
campaign.vehicles.description: Treat every vehicle as a mobility and positioning system, not only a source of damage.
campaign.vehicles.roles_title: Assign the role before the route
campaign.vehicles.roles_description: A short crew callout prevents abandoned passengers, crossed firing lanes and avoidable vehicle losses.
campaign.vehicles.scout.title: Light scout
campaign.vehicles.scout.body: Fast ground mobility is best for reading terrain, moving the squad and repositioning before heavy pressure arrives.
campaign.vehicles.scout.tactic: Driver watches the route; passenger or gunner watches flanks and calls safe dismounts.
campaign.vehicles.armor.title: Armored breakthrough
campaign.vehicles.armor.body: Heavy armor creates a moving strongpoint but can be trapped by narrow routes, elevated threats or poor retreat planning.
campaign.vehicles.armor.tactic: Enter with a reverse path and preserve distance when the firing angle is already favorable.
campaign.vehicles.air.title: Aerial support
campaign.vehicles.air.body: Air mobility can bypass terrain and expose new angles, but it also attracts fire from across an entire arena.
campaign.vehicles.air.tactic: Use terrain to break line of sight and avoid hovering above the squad's only safe cover.
campaign.vehicles.transport.title: Squad transport
campaign.vehicles.transport.body: Transport value comes from arriving together with shields, ammunition and a planned dismount position.
campaign.vehicles.transport.tactic: Call the stop before entering the objective zone and dismount on the protected side.
campaign.vehicles.coop_body: With up to four-player online co-op confirmed, agree on driver, gunner, navigator and dismount lead before a large vehicle section. Cross-play makes concise callouts and shared map language more important than platform-specific habits.
campaign.guides.meta.title: Campaign Evolved Guides – Co-op, Difficulty & Collectibles
campaign.guides.meta.description: Practical Campaign Evolved guides for first runs, four-player co-op, difficulty planning, collectible tracking and accessibility setup.
campaign.guides.title: Field guides
campaign.guides.description: Practical playbooks for preparing a run, coordinating a squad and keeping useful notes without turning every mission into a checklist.
campaign.guides.scope_notice: These playbooks are independent editorial guidance. Exact settings, checkpoints and unlock conditions will be verified in the released game before the manual presents them as facts.
campaign.guides.playbooks_description: Small habits improve every difficulty and remain useful even when encounter details change.
campaign.guides.first_run.title: First-run setup
campaign.guides.first_run.body: Use the opening mission to make the game readable and comfortable before optimizing difficulty or score.
campaign.guides.first_run.step1: Set subtitles, contrast, field of view and sensitivity before the first timed encounter.
campaign.guides.first_run.step2: Choose a difficulty that leaves room to learn navigation and weapon behavior.
campaign.guides.first_run.step3: Keep mission articles spoiler-light until an objective becomes unclear.
campaign.guides.coop.title: Co-op coordination
campaign.guides.coop.body: Up to four-player online co-op works best when recovery and movement calls are decided before combat.
campaign.guides.coop.step1: Assign lead, rear security and vehicle roles at the mission start.
campaign.guides.coop.step2: Call lifts, doors and no-return transitions before activating them.
campaign.guides.coop.step3: Keep one safe player out of the most dangerous firing lane to protect respawns.
campaign.guides.difficulty.title: Difficulty preparation
campaign.guides.difficulty.body: Higher difficulty increases the cost of bad positioning, so build reliable routines before chasing faster clears.
campaign.guides.difficulty.step1: Scout new arenas from cover and identify the safest retreat path.
campaign.guides.difficulty.step2: Spend heavy ammunition on threats that block progress, not on every durable target.
campaign.guides.difficulty.step3: Reset a broken position early instead of attempting a recovery in open ground.
campaign.guides.collectibles.title: Collectible tracking
campaign.guides.collectibles.body: Track optional discoveries at natural breaks so exploration does not fragment the objective route.
campaign.guides.collectibles.step1: Record mission, checkpoint and nearby landmark rather than relying on a screenshot alone.
campaign.guides.collectibles.step2: Finish searches before irreversible doors, lifts or timed sequences.
campaign.guides.collectibles.step3: Verify every location in Campaign Evolved instead of importing a classic-map assumption.
campaign.guides.accessibility.title: Accessibility and readability
campaign.guides.accessibility.body: A readable combat state is a tactical advantage, not a compromise.
campaign.guides.accessibility.step1: Tune subtitle size, speaker labels and contrast for the actual display distance.
campaign.guides.accessibility.step2: Reduce motion or camera effects that make target tracking uncomfortable.
campaign.guides.accessibility.step3: Use audio and reticle options that clearly communicate shield, damage and objective cues.

campaign.news.fact.crossplay: Cross-play and cross-progression are listed features.
campaign.news.source_note: These points were cross-checked against the supplied Steam and Halo Waypoint references on July 19, 2026. Platform availability, timing and feature details can change; official storefront and publisher notices remain authoritative.

campaign.about.bilingual.title: English-first publishing
campaign.about.bilingual.body: The current release publishes one canonical English version of every guide so readers and search engines always reach the same definitive page.
campaign.about.useful.title: Useful under uncertainty
campaign.about.useful.body: Verified facts, editorial tactics and provisional notes are clearly separated so the manual can help before launch without pretending to know more than the sources show.
campaign.about.method_description: Accuracy is a process: source the claim, label the confidence and update both languages together.
campaign.about.method.source: Release facts are checked against supplied official storefront and publisher references, with a visible check date.
campaign.about.method.separation: Official specifications are separated from strategy, route planning and other editorial judgment.
campaign.about.method.correction: Mission details are revised after verified source material or hands-on confirmation, not copied assumptions.
campaign.about.method.spoiler: Index pages remain spoiler-light; detailed articles state when objective or encounter information may reveal progression.
campaign.about.read_disclaimer_body: Review the site's independent status, trademark notice, accuracy limits and spoiler policy.
